body.name: p^r
body.def: For every finite \(r\in\mathcal H\), \(p^r\) is the complete canonical policy path whose announcement or decision occurs at \(\mathsf a(r)\), whose implementation status is zero at every \(t<r\), and whose first implementation occurs at \(r\) and remains in force thereafter. Announcement content and implemented-policy content are fixed components of this known path. The path \(p^\infty\) has neither announcement nor implementation at any \(t\in\mathcal T\). The mapping \(r\mapsto p^r\) is deterministic and known.
